# Robin Francis

Robin Francis is an AI product builder, software engineer, and community leader from Kerala, India. His work focuses on accessible AI products, local-first web tools, assistive technology, civic innovation, and student-community leadership.

## Key Claims

- IEEE Region 10 Outstanding Volunteer Award 2024 recipient, listed by IEEE Region 10.
- IBM watsonx GenAI Challenge second-prize team member for SoulSync, covered by The Week.
- Chairperson of IEEE Sahrdaya Student Branch, helping grow the branch from 110 to 534 members and supporting 136+ programs.
- Builder of Argus, BulkyFi, and the official STRIDE Kerala website.
- Organiser of Codex Nightline, an AI build sprint held inside a moving Kochi Metro, covered by The Hindu BusinessLine.
- Co-lead of IEEE Region 10's first international Virtual Career Fair, connecting 245 registrants with 31 global recruiters.
- Junior Programme Executive at K-DISC in the Social Enterprises and Inclusion division.
